proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10511 yuṣmad explicitly gives Hindi tum, Assamese/Bengali tumi, Gujarati tamε and Prakrit tumhē with initial t remodelled after tuvam. Selected tum/tumi/tumu/tame second-person forms fit this plural-family stem, with final u and source singular-honorific/plural distinctions retained as regional developments. This does not equate the tum stem with bare tū under 5889; local transmission remains open. Exact response: tum.
